text: {"established":["A candidate passed the released receipt check of 34 checks at stage 1.","At stage 2, the submitted candidate received a public mismatch on the released check “balance-4”; no replacement answer was supplied.","The task contract says balances cover accounts 0–6, order and files must be empty, and each stage must recompute from all packets released so far. For each transaction, select the greatest revision, breaking ties by greatest sequence; revisions replace the whole transaction. Ignore the selected record if void; otherwise debit its source and credit its destination."],"retained_observations":["The stage-1 candidate was [264,-213,224,103,91,-272,-197], with empty order and files; its note says it used highest revisions and ignored voided transactions.","The stage-2 candidate was [147,-343,55,171,-63,-216,322], with empty order and files; its note says it reconciled through revision 4, selecting highest revisions and ignoring voided transactions.","Earlier packets remain relevant, and late packets may revise old transactions. Opening balances are all zero. A candidate is required at each stage; the supplied task reports three stages."],"uncertainties":["The public mismatch identifies only the failed check, not the expected balance or cause; it does not establish that the reconciliation method is wrong.","Trial notes are unverified.
